name: @rotaris/release-guard
description: The pre-build guard of REQ-STARTUP-028: the tag's version against every place the build declares the product version (REQ-STARTUP-158), and the setup manifest's pins against the built-in default configuration's npx/uvx launches (REQ-STARTUP-059) — one stage, exit 1 on either (REQ-STARTUP-149). Run as `pnpm release:guard <tag>` (ADR-0054, first-release-plan.md §4.1).
